scenario.description: A studio distribution producer must approve the final delivery package for a documentary's one-night festival premiere, including exhibition permissions, the required credit line, audio master, frame rate, and delivery actions.

shared_context.S1: The documentary is scheduled for a one-night premiere at the Harbor Film Festival.
shared_context.S2: The current delivery draft includes an in-person screening, a possible festival livestream, a standard music credit, and a stereo audio master.
shared_context.S3: Mara has final approval authority for the delivery package.
shared_context.S4: Before approval, Mara conducts the routine rights and technical signoff round in which the clearance counsel and post-production supervisor report any constraints and required delivery changes.

PF1.text: Leon confirmed with the publisher this morning that the signed license permits only the in-person festival screening, prohibits a livestream, and requires the exact credit line "Song 'Blue Hour' written by Nia Cole, published by Northstar Music"; he has not entered the confirmation in the delivery tracker because the publisher's email is still being attached to the clearance file.

PF2.text: Suki's venue ingest test confirmed yesterday that Harbor Film Festival accepts this title only as a 5.1 discrete DCP mastered at 24 fps; the current stereo draft is rejected, and she has not sent the test report to Mara because it remains in the post-production technical folder awaiting the final export log.

acceptance_conditions: The festival livestream must be prohibited.
The exact publisher-required credit line must be used.
The delivery must use a 5.1 discrete DCP audio master.
The DCP must be mastered at 24 fps.
A rights-restriction or rights-documentation commitment must be logged.
A technical-repackage or technical-documentation commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C2: decisions['credit_line'] == "Song 'Blue Hour' written by Nia Cole, published by Northstar Music"
content_checks.C5: any((c['target'] == 'Leon' or c['target'] == 'clearance' or c['target'] == 'delivery package') and ('delivery tracker' in c['detail'] or 'publisher' in c['detail'] or 'license' in c['detail'] or 'livestream' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any((c['target'] == 'Suki' or c['target'] == 'post-production') and ('ingest test report' in c['detail'] or 'test report' in c['detail'] or '5.1 discrete DCP' in c['detail'] or 'remaster' in c['detail'] or 'final export log' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The publisher's confirmed license changes livestream_allowed to False, replaces the standard credit with the exact Northstar Music line, and requires a logged rights-restriction action.
The venue ingest test changes the audio_master from stereo to 5.1 discrete DCP, fixes the frame_rate at 24 fps, and requires a logged technical-repackage action.
